meta.title: Why We Should Do a Play

paragraphs: Posted by Leo. Our class show is coming, and Teacher Kim asked everybody for an opinion. The show will be in the school hall, and many parents will come. Should we do a play or a quiz? I think that we should do a play, and I have three reasons. I like plays, because I like to act. Mia and May agree with me.

My first reason is that a play uses everybody. Every child can have a part, because a play has a lot of small jobs. One child can be a robot, and another child can be a doctor. Other children can make the costumes, and some can open the curtain. In a quiz, only two or three children speak, and the others wait. Mia wants to be the doctor, and I want to be the robot. May wants to open the curtain.

My second reason is that a play lets us make funny props. A woman at the market gave us a big refrigerator box. It can be a spaceship, because it is tall and square. We can paint the box silver. Pat will help us to paint it. May has a small perfume bottle, and it can be a magic bottle in the story. "Is that alright with you?" asked Mia. "Yes, it is perfect for the play," said May.

My third reason is that a play is fun for the audience. I saw a school play in the hall, and I was amazed. The children made the whole room laugh. The play was about a lost dog. A child in a dog costume came on the stage, and everybody clapped. Mia asked, "What exactly was so good about it?" I said, "The play itself was simple, but everybody worked together."

Some friends say that a quiz is easier, and that is true. A quiz needs no costumes, and it needs no big props. However, a quiz is only a list of questions. A play tells a story, and a story gives the audience a good feeling. A quiz can be fun too. We can play a short quiz after the play.
Teacher Kim will ask the class to vote on Thursday. We have two weeks to practice. Is a play alright with you? Please tell me your opinion and your reason.
text.summary: Leo writes his opinion about the Explorers' show in the school hall. He thinks that the class should do a play, and he gives three reasons with because. He also says what a quiz show can do.
